VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are heading to the International Space Station to train astronauts for spacewalks in collaboration with the European Space Agency.

VR.title: X-Plane & iRacing PC VR Streaming Clients Launched For Apple Vision Pro
VR.summary: X-Plane 12 and iRacing are now playable in VR on Apple Vision Pro, streamed from your PC with physical accessories integrated.

VR.title: Supernatural To Return Under New Independent Company As Coaches Rejoin Platform
VR.summary: Supernatural is returning under a new independent company as Meta hands back the IP to its original founders and coaches.

VR.title: KRVR Supports Apple Vision Pro's Foveated Streaming For SteamVR Games
VR.summary: KRVR app enables foveated streaming for SteamVR games on Apple Vision Pro, enhancing the VR gaming experience.

VR.title: This Quest Accessory Wants to Turn Your Brain Activity Into VR Avatar Control
VR.summary: PiEEG launches a brain-computer interface for Quest headsets, allowing users to control avatars with brain signals and facial expressions.

VR.title: ‘Beat Saber’ Turns 8, Bringing 3 New Free Tracks to VR’s Favorite Block-slashing Rhythm Game
VR.summary: Beat Saber celebrates its 8th anniversary by releasing three new free tracks for players on Quest and SteamVR headsets.

AI.title: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
AI.summary: Microsoft announced new AI initiatives at its Build conference, including in-house reasoning models and a super app, signaling its competitive stance in the AI landscape.

AI.title: Microsoft’s first advanced reasoning AI is here
AI.summary: Microsoft unveiled its first advanced reasoning AI model, MAI-Thinking-1, marking a significant step in its AI development strategy.

AI.title: Amazon’s search bar will invent AI-generated products you can’t buy
AI.summary: Amazon's updated search bar will now generate AI images of products based on user descriptions, enhancing the shopping experience.

AI.title: Google must let publishers opt out of AI Search features, rules UK
AI.summary: A UK regulatory ruling mandates Google to allow publishers to opt out of AI Search features, giving them more control over their content.

AI.title: Google’s Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
AI.summary: Google's Phone app will now alert users to potential AI impersonation scams by flagging suspicious calls that appear to come from their contacts.

AI.title: AI has a water problem — Google thinks it has a fix
AI.summary: Google is addressing environmental concerns related to AI data centers by committing to increase water availability for local communities.

NFL.title: QB Wilson announces retirement after 14 seasons
NFL.summary: Ten-time Pro Bowl quarterback Russell Wilson announced his retirement from the NFL after 14 seasons, transitioning to a role with CBS Sports.

NFL.title: Sources: TE Washington, Steelers reach 4-yr. deal
NFL.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers and tight end Darnell Washington have agreed to a four-year, $42 million contract extension.

NFL.title: George Kittle continues push for Week 1 return
NFL.summary: George Kittle is optimistic about returning for the 49ers' season opener after recovering from a torn Achilles.

NFL.title: Packers without Parsons until at least mid-October...
NFL.summary: Packers star Micah Parsons will not debut until at least mid-October as he continues to recover from a torn ACL and meniscus.

NFL.title: 49ers' Williams acknowledges career is near end
NFL.summary: Trent Williams reflected on his career, indicating he may retire after two more seasons with the 49ers.

NFL.title: Warrant issued for Aiyuk after viral speeding post...
NFL.summary: A warrant has been issued for 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk following a viral post showing him speeding.
